subject.title: Bug: partialArgs JSON duplication in agentTurn cron jobs with isolated sessionTarget

question: Should OpenClaw repair only identical duplicated complete tool-call argument objects, or should it change the OpenAI-compatible stream parser contract to treat affected provider chunks as cumulative snapshots?
rationale: Both choices affect malformed tool-call argument recovery before tool execution, and the existing candidate PR proves the risk of silently discarding conflicting structured suffixes.

options.title: Repair identical duplicates only
options.body: Accept a narrow fix that discards a repeated complete object only when every parsed object is semantically identical, while conflicting structured suffixes still fail closed.

options.title: Treat chunks as cumulative snapshots
options.body: Change selected provider stream handling to replace rather than append cumulative argument chunks, requiring live provider proof and compatibility checks for normal incremental providers.

options.title: Keep current fail-closed behavior
options.body: Leave duplicated structured JSON rejected until maintainers have stronger live evidence that repairing it is safe.

recommendation.title: Repair identical duplicates only
recommendation.body: Accept a narrow fix that discards a repeated complete object only when every parsed object is semantically identical, while conflicting structured suffixes still fail closed.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest history on malformed tool-call argument recovery and current helper maintenance.
